title: Mind Yours! Amy Luciani Claps Back At Critics Questioning Her Reconciliation With Dwight Howard Following Past Allegations (PHOTOS) - NewsBreak
text:
By Desjah ,
4 hours ago Amy Luciani and Dwight Howard have folks in their business, and Amy is making it clear she’s not losing any sleep over the opinions surrounding her marriage. This week, Amy took to her Instagram comments to clap back at people questioning the couple’s decision to stay together, and she didn’t hold back when responding to those who seemingly couldn’t understand their reconciliation.
RELATED: Amy Luciani Opens Up About Reconciling With Husband Dwight Howard After Publicly Accusing Him Of Drug Use (VIDEO) Amy Luciani Tells Marriage Critics to “ Unfollow” Her After one person asked, “why are they so mad?” Amy responded, “Me and my husband stayed married and it has some people livid and it’s scary actually to watch. I have neve in life cared about strangers this much.” Another commenter wrote, “Amy I love you but please don’t piss me off this why you stay out peoples business fr,” prompting Amy to reply, “just unfollow Mama.. You gone stay pissed off over here.” Chile, Amy seems to be telling folks that if they can’t get with her decisions, they can always remove themselves from the conversation!
Amy Said “Ashamed, WHO?!” Another person questioned whether Amy felt any shame about reconciling with Dwight Howard, writing, “You not shame? At least tell us how yall made it back here since yall told us what happened before.” Amy made it clear that shame wasn’t on her mind, responding, “not at all I’m so glad me and my Husband worked through it and still working through it. I woke up today feeling no shame, but more so blessed, happy, excited, thankful.” While Amy didn’t go into further detail about how her and Dwight worked through their issues, she expressed gratitude for where their relationship stands today. And whether the internet agrees with their decision or not, Amy appears content with continuing to work on her marriage without apologizing to the peanut gallery.
You Already Know Folks Have Thoughts Folks wasted no time running to T he Shade Room’s Instagram comment section to weigh in on the couple’s decision to stay married. S ome argued that Amy put her business out there in the first place, so she can’t be mad when people have questions. Meanwhile, others weren’t buying the reconciliation at all, calling the situation a whole mess.
One Instagram user @ iam_melissaodum said, “ Well, don’t care to come tell the strangers your business!”
This Instagram user @ kayleedaje added, “ They just high and in love. 😂😂😂 they had a little fight yall”
And, Instagram user @ ryork2601 wrote, “ Just leave us out the group chat with ya’ll and that Snow white next time 😂”
Meanwhile, Instagram user @ iamlaladorsey shared, “ Girl BYE! You put us in yall business and then get mad when we follow up. 🙄😂”
While Instagram user @ _jaliciaa commented, “‘ as a first time wife’ girl it’s only supposed to be one time😩😂😂”
Finally, Instagram user @mr_grindhard4 claimed, “ I pray a love like that never find me”
Wait…What Exactly Went Down Between Them? ICYMI, Amy previously addressed the viral livestream that appeared to show cocaine while she accused her husband, Dwight Howard, of drug use. During a past interview , Luciani clarified that the substance shown was not cocaine and admitted she was wrong for publicly airing their marital issues while caught up in anger and emotion. Her comments come amid ongoing divorce drama, as Howard has denied the drug-use allegations and the former couple’s relationship continues to play out publicly.
